APEX ELECTRICAL CONTRACTORS
Commercial & Healthcare Electrical Construction - Atlanta, GA
PROPOSAL SUMMARY
Proposal Date: August 7, 2026
Submitted To: Crestmark Construction Partners
Attention: Daniel Cho, Senior Estimator
Project: Falcon Medical Center Expansion
Project Number: 26-0147
Bid Package: 26-0147-BP-26 - Division 26 Electrical
Base Bid: $191,850.00
Bid Validity: 30 calendar days from the Proposal Date
Anticipated Duration: 18 weeks from mobilization, subject to approved project schedule
Apex Electrical Contractors is pleased to submit the enclosed proposal for the Division 26 electrical scope of
work on the Falcon Medical Center Expansion, based on Contract Drawings Revision 3 and the Project
Manual issued for bid. This proposal summary, together with the Scope of Work, Allowances and Alternates,
and Clarifications and Exclusions sections that follow, constitutes our complete base bid submission.
Apex Electrical Contractors - Proposal for Falcon Medical Center Expansion, Project 26-0147, Bid Package 26-0147-BP-26 -
Page 1 of 5

APEX ELECTRICAL CONTRACTORS
Commercial & Healthcare Electrical Construction - Atlanta, GA
SCOPE OF WORK
The following electrical scope is included in our Base Bid of $191,850.00 for Bid Package 26-0147-BP-26,
unless separately identified as an Allowance, Alternate, or Exclusion elsewhere in this proposal:
1 Electrical mobilization and supervision for the duration of Apex's on-site work.
2 Branch power rough-in for all areas shown on the electrical Contract Drawings.
3 Lighting branch circuitry serving all fixture locations shown on the Contract Drawings.
4 Lighting fixtures, furnished and installed within the $42,500.00 lighting fixture allowance described in the
Allowances and Alternates section.
5 Electrical permit fees associated with the Division 26 scope of work.
6 Temporary power required for Apex's own electrical work during construction.
7 Fire alarm device connections shown within the electrical Contract Drawings.
8 Testing of installed feeders and branch circuits in accordance with the Project Manual.
9 Standard closeout documentation for Apex's electrical scope, including as-built markups and warranty
letters.
10 Normal working-hours coordination with Crestmark's field superintendent and other trades.

ID Description Amount Status

Apex Electrical Contractors - Proposal for Falcon Medical Center Expansion, Project 26-0147, Bid Package 26-0147-BP-26 -
Page 3 of 5

APEX ELECTRICAL CONTRACTORS
Commercial & Healthcare Electrical Construction - Atlanta, GA
CLARIFICATIONS AND EXCLUSIONS
This proposal is based on the Contract Drawings (Revision 3) and Project Manual issued for bid. The
following items are explicitly excluded from our Base Bid and are not included in any Allowance or Alternate
stated elsewhere in this proposal:
1 Structured cabling and other Division 27 Communications systems.
2 Security, access control, and other Division 28 Electronic Safety and Security systems.
3 Utility-company charges, fees, and service-connection costs.
4 Performance and payment bond. Bonding is excluded from the Base Bid and is available as an
add-alternate if required by Crestmark; pricing will be furnished upon request.
Apex Electrical Contractors - Proposal for Falcon Medical Center Expansion, Project 26-0147, Bid Package 26-0147-BP-26 -
Page 4 of 5

APEX ELECTRICAL CONTRACTORS
Commercial & Healthcare Electrical Construction - Atlanta, GA
COMMERCIAL AND SCHEDULE TERMS
Anticipated duration is 18 weeks from mobilization, subject to an approved project schedule issued by
Crestmark Construction Partners. Apex will coordinate normal working-hours access with the Crestmark
field superintendent and will participate in scheduled preconstruction and trade-coordination meetings for
the Division 26 scope of work. This proposal remains valid for 30 calendar days from the Proposal Date
stated on Page 1.
Respectfully submitted,
Jordan Wells

award.narrative: Recommend award to Ironclad Power & Electric at $186,250 leveled, scoring 95.4 of 100, ahead of Apex Electrical Contractors at 91.9 (3.5 points). This is also the lowest leveled bid. It is not the lowest submitted bid: Voltage Systems Inc. submitted $167,400 but rises to $223,700 once excluded scope is priced. Strongest factor is leveled cost at 100 of 100 ($186,250 leveled, the lowest leveled bid); weakest is experience and past performance at 85 (2.4% change-order rate, 96% on-time closeout, 5 package(s) completed over 7 years). 2 bidder(s) were excluded before scoring: Meridian Electric & Controls ($2,300 above the recommendation) -- EMR of 1.12 (2025) exceeds the 1.00 maximum. Voltage Systems Inc. ($37,450 above the recommendation) -- Umbrella / excess liability carried at $2,000,000 against a $5,000,000 requirement. Weights applied: leveled cost 40%, experience and past performance 30%, safety record 20%, schedule and capacity 10%.

prequalification.policy_note: Safety and insurance are gates, not weights. A subcontractor over the EMR maximum or under a required insurance limit is removed from award consideration before price is discussed, because carrying that risk is not something a lower number buys back.

coverage.policy_note: A package with fewer than three responsive bidders is not competitively bid, and the leveled spread stops being evidence of a market price. Coverage is tracked from the invitation out, not from the bids in, because the bids that never arrived are the ones that do not show up in any comparison.
